body.statement: The observed-marginal fixed-radius model is a nonempty proper instrumental subclass of the published causal-isotonic observed-law model: \(\varnothing\ne\mathcal M\subsetneq\mathcal M_{\mathrm{WGC}}\). Membership in \(\mathcal M\) means that the observed law admits at least one causal full-data extension satisfying the maintained continuous conditional-potential-mean version convention and also satisfies the global fixed-radius \(C^s\), interior strict-slope, bounded-density, and effective-variance restrictions.
body.justification: The inclusion makes explicit that the excursion transfer theorem is asserted on an instrumental strengthened regular subclass, not on the full published causal-isotonic model.
body.gap: Westling, Gilbert, and Carone (2020) provide the broader monotone causal-isotonic framework; the global fixed-radius \(C^s\) restrictions used here are additional and are not attributed to that paper or to Takatsu and Westling (2025).
body.consumer: Readers can distinguish which published causal-isotonic applications fall within the simultaneous calibration theorem and which require a separate extension.
